concerns.text: Task T019b implements a 'Mock Annotation Generator' to simulate human review. While the Plan (Phase 0.5) and Spec (FR-011) require a 'manual spot-check' (human-in-the-loop), T019b replaces this with a deterministic mock. There is NO task to actually perform the manual review or ingest real human annotations. This leaves FR-011 (manual spot-check) and SC-003 (validation) unfulfilled by a real process, violating the requirement to estimate the false-negative rate via human validation.

Task T026 implements a 'Stratified Mann-Whitney U Test' with Fisher's method aggregation. The Spec FR-006 explicitly mandates a standard 'Mann-Whitney U test' without stratification. While the Plan mentions 'stratified statistical analysis' as a goal, the Spec (the source of truth for requirements) does not authorize this specific method. There is no task covering the standard MWU test required by FR-006, and T026 covers a method not explicitly required by the Spec, creating a gap in FR-006 coverage.

Task T018c enforces a hard stop (DataQualityError) if data quality < 95% (SC-003). The Spec SC-003 states data quality is 'measured against... a success threshold of ≥ 95% and logging of exclusion reasons'. It does NOT mandate halting the pipeline. The Spec's Edge Cases section implies logging and continuing. T018c covers a behavior (halting) not required by the Spec, while the Spec's requirement to 'measure and log' is only partially covered. A task explicitly logging the rate and continuing (if <95% is acceptable per spec interpretation) is missing.

Task T023b calculates skewness, kurtosis, and Shapiro-Wilk p-values. Spec SC-002 requires measuring 'mean, median, standard deviation, and quartiles'. T023b adds extra metrics not required by SC-002. There is NO task explicitly calculating the required 'mean, median, standard deviation, and quartiles' for the groups as defined in SC-002. T023 covers descriptive stats but T023b is the only one mentioning specific distribution stats, leaving the core SC-002 metrics potentially uncovered or conflated.

Task T028 implements a Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis. Neither Spec FR-006 nor Plan Phase 1 explicitly mandates a 'Monte Carlo' method for sensitivity analysis. The Plan mentions 'Apply bias-correction using spot-check error rates' but does not define the algorithm. T028 covers a specific implementation not traced to a requirement. There is NO task covering the generic requirement to 'perform sensitivity analysis' or 'bias-correction' as defined in the Plan, leaving the Plan's intent uncovered by a specific task.

Task T012b requires fetching 'ALL commits' for every PR. The Spec Edge Cases and Plan Constraints mention a 'bounded dataset (<500MB)' and '6-hour execution window'. While T012b mentions pagination, it lacks a task to implement a 'limit' or 'sampling' strategy to ensure the pipeline completes within the Plan's constraints. The requirement to fetch 'ALL' conflicts with the Plan's feasibility constraints, and no task addresses this conflict (e.g., 'Fetch up to N commits' or 'Sample commits').

Task T026b logs a conclusion based on p-value but does not define an artifact for the 'No significant difference' case. Spec SC-004 requires measuring against the p-value threshold. The Plan Phase 2 requires 'Assemble final report'. T034/T036b cover the report, but T026b is the only task handling the 'No significant' logic. A task explicitly ensuring the report includes the 'No significant difference' finding (as a valid result) is missing or conflated with T026b.
